name: External Purpose 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external purpose code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

BKDF.name: Bank Loan Delayed Draw Funding
BKDF.definition: Delayed draw funding. Certain issuers may utilize delayed draw loans whereby the lender is committed to fund cash within a specified period once a call is made by the issuer. The lender receives a fee for entering into such a commitment.

BKFE.name: Bank Loan Fees
BKFE.definition: Bank loan fees. Cash activity related to specific bank loan fees, including (a) agent / assignment fees; (b) amendment fees; (c) commitment fees; (d) consent fees; (e) cost of carry fees; (f) delayed compensation fees; (g) facility fees; (h) fronting fees; (i) funding fees; (j) letter of credit assignment fees.

BKFM.name: Bank Loan Funding Memo
BKFM.definition: Bank loan funding memo. Net cash movement for the loan contract final notification when sent separately from the loan contract final notification instruction.

BKIP.name: Bank Loan Accrued Interest Payment
BKIP.definition: Accrued interest payments. Specific to bank loans.

BKPP.name: Bank Loan Principal Paydown
BKPP.definition: Principal paydowns. Specific to bank loans

CBLK.name: Card Bulk Clearing
CBLK.definition: A Service that is settling money for a bulk of card transactions, while referring to a specific transaction file or other information like terminal ID, card acceptor ID or other transaction details.

CDCB.name: Card Payment With Cash Back
CDCB.definition: Purchase of Goods and Services with additional Cash disbursement at the POI (Cashback).

CDCD.name: Cash Disbursement Cash Settlement
CDCD.definition: ATM Cash Withdrawal in an unattended or Cash Advance in an attended environment (POI or bank counter).

CDCS.name: Cash Disbursement With Surcharging
CDCS.definition: ATM Cash Withdrawal in an unattended or Cash Advance in an attended environment (POI or bank counter) with surcharging.

CDDP.name: Card Deferred Payment
CDDP.definition: A combined service which enables the card acceptor to perform an authorisation for a temporary amount and a completion for the final amount within a limited time frame. Deferred Payment is only available in the unattended environment. Examples where this service is widely used are unattended petrol pumps and phone booths.

CDOC.name: Original Credit
CDOC.definition: A service which allows the card acceptor to effect a credit to a cardholder' account. Unlike a Merchant Refund, an Original Credit is not preceded by a card payment. This service is used for example for crediting winnings from gaming.

CDQC.name: Quasi Cash
CDQC.definition: Purchase of Goods which are equivalent to cash like coupons in casinos.

ETUP.name: E Purse Top Up
ETUP.definition: Transaction is related to a Service that is first reserving money from a card account and then is loading an e-purse application by this amount.

FCOL.name: Fee Collection
FCOL.definition: A Service that is settling card transaction related fees between two parties.

MTUP.name: Mobile Top Up
MTUP.definition: A Service that is first reserving money from a card account and then is loading a prepaid mobile phone amount by this amount.

ACCT.name: Account Management
ACCT.definition: Transaction moves funds between 2 accounts of same account holder at the same bank.

CASH.name: Cash Management Transfer
CASH.definition: Transaction is a general cash management instruction.

COLL.name: Collection Payment
COLL.definition: Transaction is a collection of funds initiated via a credit transfer or direct debit.

CSDB.name: Cash Disbursement Cash Management
CSDB.definition: Transaction is related to cash disbursement.

DEPT.name: Deposit
DEPT.definition: Transaction is releted to a payment of deposit.

INTC.name: Intra Company Payment
INTC.definition: Transaction is an intra-company payment, ie, a payment between two companies belonging to the same group.

INTP.name: Intra Party Payment
INTP.definition: Transaction is a payment between two accounts belonging to the same party (intra-party payment), where party is a natural person (identified by a private ID, not organisation ID).

LIMA.name: Liquidity Management
LIMA.definition: Bank initiated account transfer to support zero target balance management, pooling or sweeping.

NETT.name: Netting
NETT.definition: Transaction is related to a netting operation.

BFWD.name: Bond Forward
BFWD.definition: Cash collateral related to any securities traded out beyond 3 days which include treasury notes, JGBs and Gilts.

CCIR.name: Cross Currency IRS
CCIR.definition: Cash Collateral related to a Cross Currency Interest Rate Swap, indicating the exchange of fixed interest payments in one currency for those in another.

CCPC.name: CCP Cleared Initial Margin
CCPC.definition: Cash Collateral associated with an ISDA or Central Clearing Agreement that is covering the initial margin requirements for OTC trades clearing through a CCP.

CCPM.name: CCP Cleared Variation Margin
CCPM.definition: Cash Collateral associated with an ISDA or Central Clearing Agreement that is covering the variation margin requirements for OTC trades clearing through a CCP.

CCSM.name: CCP Cleared Initial Margin Segregated Cash
CCSM.definition: CCP Segregated initial margin: Initial margin on OTC Derivatives cleared through a CCP that requires segregation.

CRDS.name: Credit Default Swap
CRDS.definition: Cash collateral related to trading of credit default swap.

CRPR.name: Cross Product
CRPR.definition: Cash collateral related to a combination of various types of trades.

CRSP.name: Credit Support
CRSP.definition: Cash collateral related to cash lending/borrowing; letter of Credit; signing of master agreement.

CRTL.name: Credit Line
CRTL.definition: Cash collateral related to opening of a credit line before trading.

EQPT.name: Equity Option
EQPT.definition: Cash collateral related to trading of equity option (Also known as stock options).

EQUS.name: Equity Swap
EQUS.definition: Cash collateral related to equity swap trades where the return of an equity is exchanged for either a fixed or a floating rate of interest.

EXPT.name: Exotic Option
EXPT.definition: Cash collateral related to trading of an exotic option for example a non-standard option.

EXTD.name: Exchange Traded Derivatives
EXTD.definition: Cash collateral related to trading of exchanged traded derivatives in general (Opposite to Over the Counter (OTC)).

FIXI.name: Fixed Income
FIXI.definition: Cash collateral related to a fixed income instrument

FWBC.name: Forward Broker Owned Cash Collateral
FWBC.definition: Cash collateral payment against a Master Forward Agreement (MFA) where the cash is held in a segregated account and is not available for use by the client. Includes any instruments with a forward settling date such TBAs, repurchase agreements and bond forwards

FWCC.name: Forward Client Owned Cash Collateral
FWCC.definition: Cash collateral payment against a Master Forward Agreement (MFA) where the cash is owned and may be used by the client when returned. Includes any instruments with a forward settling date such TBAs, repurchase agreements and bond forwards

FWSB.name: Forward Broker Owned Cash Collateral Segregated
FWSB.definition: Any cash payment related to the collateral for a Master Agreement forward, which is segregated, and not available for use by the client. Example master agreement forwards include TBA, repo and Bond Forwards.

FWSC.name: Forward Client Owned Segregated Cash Collateral
FWSC.definition: Any cash payment related to the collateral for a Master agreement forward, which is owned by the client and is available for use by the client when it is returned to them from the segregated account. Example master agreement forwards include TBA, repo and Bond Forwards.

MARG.name: Daily Margin On Listed Derivatives
MARG.definition: Daily margin on listed derivatives – not segregated as collateral associated with an FCM agreement. Examples include listed futures and options margin payments; premiums for listed options not covered in the MT54X message.

MBSB.name: MBS Broker Owned Cash Collateral
MBSB.definition: MBS Broker Owned Segregated (40Act/Dodd Frank) Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for a Mortgage Back Security, which is segregated, and not available for use by the client.

MBSC.name: MBS Client Owned Cash Collateral
MBSC.definition: MBS Client Owned Cash Segregated (40Act/Dodd Frank) Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for a Mortgage Back Security, which is owned by the client and is available for use by the client when it is returned to them from the segregated account

MGCC.name: Futures Initial Margin
MGCC.definition: Initial futures margin. Where such payment is owned by the client and is available for use by them on return

MGSC.name: Futures Initial Margin Client Owned Segregated Cash Collateral
MGSC.definition: Margin Client Owned Segregated Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for initial futures margin, which is owned by the client and is available for use by the client when it is returned to them from the segregated account.

OCCC.name: Client Owned OCC Pledged Collateral
OCCC.definition: Client owned collateral identified as eligible for OCC pledging.

OPBC.name: OTC Option Broker Owned Cash Collateral
OPBC.definition: Cash collateral payment for OTC options associated with an FCM agreement. Where such payment is segregated and not available for use by the client

OPCC.name: OTC Option Client Owned Cash Collateral
OPCC.definition: Cash collateral payment for OTC options associated with an FCM agreement. Where such payment is not segregated and is available for use by the client upon return

OPSB.name: OTC Option Broker Owned Segregated Cash Collateral
OPSB.definition: Option Broker Owned Segregated Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for an OTC option, which is segregated, and not available for use by the client.

OPSC.name: OTC Option Client Owned Cash Segregated Cash Collateral
OPSC.definition: Option Client Owned Cash Segregated Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for an OTC option, which is owned by the client and is available for use by the client when it is returned to them from the segregated account

OPTN.name: FX Option
OPTN.definition: Cash collateral related to trading of option on Foreign Exchange.

OTCD.name: OTC Derivatives
OTCD.definition: Cash collateral related to Over-the-counter (OTC) Derivatives in general for example contracts which are traded and privately negotiated.

REPO.name: Repurchase Agreement
REPO.definition: Cash collateral related to a repurchase agreement transaction.

RPBC.name: Bilateral Repo Broker Owned Collateral
RPBC.definition: Bi-lateral repo broker owned collateral associated with a repo master agreement – GMRA or MRA Master Repo Agreements.

RPCC.name: Repo Client Owned Collateral
RPCC.definition: Repo client owned collateral associated with a repo master agreement – GMRA or MRA Master Repo Agreements

RPSB.name: Bilateral Repo Broker Owned Segregated Cash Collateral
RPSB.definition: Bi-lateral repo broker owned segregated cash collateral associated with a repo master agreement.

RPSC.name: Bilateral Repo Client Owned Segregated Cash Collateral
RPSC.definition: Repo client owned segregated collateral associated with a repo master agreement.

RVPO.name: Reverse Repurchase Agreement
RVPO.definition: Cash collateral related to a reverse repurchase agreement transaction.

SBSC.name: Securities Buy Sell Sell Buy Back
SBSC.definition: Cash collateral related to a Securities Buy Sell Sell Buy Back

SCIE.name: Single Currency IRS Exotic
SCIE.definition: Cash collateral related to Exotic single currency interest rate swap.

SCIR.name: Single Currency IRS
SCIR.definition: Cash collateral related to Single Currency Interest Rate Swap.

SCRP.name: Securities Cross Products
SCRP.definition: Cash collateral related to Combination of securities-related exposure types.

SHBC.name: Broker Owned Collateral Short Sale
SHBC.definition: Short Sale broker owned collateral associated with a prime broker agreement.

SHCC.name: Client Owned Collateral Short Sale
SHCC.definition: Short Sale client owned collateral associated with a prime brokerage agreement.

SHSL.name: Short Sell
SHSL.definition: Cash Collateral related to a Short Sell

SLEB.name: Securities Lending And Borrowing
SLEB.definition: Cash collateral related to Securities lending and borrowing.

SLOA.name: Secured Loan
SLOA.definition: Cash collateral related to a Secured loan.

SWBC.name: Swap Broker Owned Cash Collateral
SWBC.definition: Cash collateral payment for swaps associated with an ISDA agreement. . Where such payment is segregated and|not available for use by the client. Includes any cash collateral payments made under the terms of a CSA agreement|for instruments such as swaps and FX forwards.

SWCC.name: Swap Client Owned Cash Collateral
SWCC.definition: Cash collateral payment for swaps associated with an ISDA agreement. Where such payment is not segregated and|is available for use by the client upon return. Includes any cash collateral payments made under the terms of a CSA|agreement for instruments such as swaps and FX forwards.

SWPT.name: Swaption
SWPT.definition: Cash collateral related to an option on interest rate swap.

SWSB.name: Swaps Broker Owned Segregated Cash Collateral
SWSB.definition: Swaps Broker Owned Segregated Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for Swap margin ,|which is segregated, and not available for use by the client. This includes any collateral identified in a CSA|agreement such as Swap or FX Forward collateral.

SWSC.name: Swaps Client Owned Segregated Cash Collateral
SWSC.definition: Swaps Client Owned Segregated Cash Collateral - Any cash payment related to the collateral for Swap margin,|which is owned by the client and is available for use by the client when returned from the segregated account. This|includes any collateral identified in a CSA agreement such as Swap or FX Forward collateral.

TBAS.name: To Be Announced
TBAS.definition: Cash collateral related to a To Be Announced (TBA)

TBBC.name: TBA Broker Owned Cash Collateral
TBBC.definition: Cash collateral payment (segregated) for TBA securities associated with a TBA Master Agreement. Where such payment is segregated and not available for use by the client.

TBCC.name: TBA Client Owned Cash Collateral
TBCC.definition: Cash collateral payment (for use by client)for TBA securities associated with a TBA Master Agreement. Where such payment is not segregated and is available for use by the client upon return.

TRCP.name: Treasury Cross Product
TRCP.definition: Cash collateral related to a combination of treasury-related exposure types.

AGRT.name: Agricultural Transfer
AGRT.definition: Transaction is related to the agricultural domain.

AREN.name: Accounts Receivables Entry
AREN.definition: Transaction is related to a payment associated with an Account Receivable Entry

BEXP.name: Business Expenses
BEXP.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of business expenses.

BOCE.name: Back Office Conversion Entry
BOCE.definition: Transaction is related to a payment associated with a Back Office Conversion Entry

COMC.name: Commercial Payment
COMC.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of commercial credit or debit. (formerly CommercialCredit).

GDDS.name: Purchase Sale Of Goods
GDDS.definition: Transaction is related to purchase and sale of goods.

GDSV.name: Purchase Sale Of Goods And Services
GDSV.definition: Transaction is related to purchase and sale of goods and services.

GSCB.name: Purchase Sale Of Goods And Services With Cash Back
GSCB.definition: Transaction is related to purchase and sale of goods and services with cash back.

LICF.name: License Fee
LICF.definition: Transaction is payment of a license fee.

MP2B.name: Mobile P 2 B Payment
MP2B.definition: A service which enables a user to use an app on its mobile to pay a merchant or other business payees by initiating a payment message. Within this context, the account information or an alias of the payee might be transported through different channels to the app, for example QR Code, NFC, Bluetooth, other Networks.

POPE.name: Point Of Purchase Entry
POPE.definition: Transaction is related to a payment associated with a Point of Purchase Entry.

ROYA.name: Royalties
ROYA.definition: Transaction is the payment of royalties.

SCVE.name: Purchase Sale Of Services
SCVE.definition: Transaction is related to purchase and sale of services.

SERV.name: Service Charges
SERV.definition: Transaction is related to service charges charged by a service provider.

SUBS.name: Subscription
SUBS.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of information or entertainment services either in printed or electronic form.

SUPP.name: Supplier Payment
SUPP.definition: Transaction is related to a payment to a supplier.

TRAD.name: Commercial
TRAD.definition: Transaction is related to a trade services operation.

CHAR.name: Charity Payment
CHAR.definition: Transaction is a payment for charity reasons.

COMT.name: Consumer Third Party Consolidated Payment
COMT.definition: Transaction is a payment used by a third party who can collect funds to pay on behalf of consumers, ie credit counseling or bill payment companies.

MP2P.name: Mobile P 2 P Payment
MP2P.definition: A service which enables a user to use an app on its mobile to initiate moving funds from his/her bank account to another person’s bank account while not using the account number  but an alias information like an MSISDN as account addressing information in his/her app.

ECPG.name: Guaranteed E Payment
ECPG.definition: E-Commerce payment with payment guarantee of the issuing bank.

ECPU.name: Non Guaranteed E Payment
ECPU.definition: E-Commerce payment without payment guarantee of the issuing bank.

CLPR.name: Car Loan Principal Repayment
CLPR.definition: Transaction is a payment of car loan principal payment.

COMP.name: Compensation Payment
COMP.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of a compensation relating to interest loss/value date adjustment and can include fees.

DBTC.name: Debit Collection Payment
DBTC.definition: Collection of funds initiated via a debit transfer.

GOVI.name: Government Insurance
GOVI.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of government insurance.

HLRP.name: Property Loan Repayment
HLRP.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of property loan.

HLST.name: Property Loan Settlement
HLST.definition: Transaction is related to the settlement of a property loan.

INPC.name: Insurance Premium Car
INPC.definition: Transaction is a payment of car insurance premium.

INPR.name: Insurance Premium Refund
INPR.definition: Transaction is related to an insurance premium refund.

INSC.name: Payment Of Insurance Claim
INSC.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of an insurance claim.

INSU.name: Insurance Premium
INSU.definition: Transaction is payment of an insurance premium.

LBRI.name: Labor Insurance
LBRI.definition: Transaction is a payment of labor insurance.

LIFI.name: Life Insurance
LIFI.definition: Transaction is a payment of life insurance.

LOAN.name: Loan
LOAN.definition: Transaction is related to transfer of loan to borrower.

LOAR.name: Loan Repayment
LOAR.definition: Transaction is related to repayment of loan to lender.

PENO.name: Payment Based On Enforcement Order
PENO.definition: Payment based on enforcement orders except those arising from judicial alimony decrees.

PPTI.name: Property Insurance
PPTI.definition: Transaction is a payment of property insurance.

RINP.name: Recurring Installment Payment
RINP.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of a recurring installment made at regular intervals.

TRFD.name: Trust Fund
TRFD.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of a trust fund.

FORW.name: Forward Foreign Exchange
FORW.definition: FX trades with a value date in the future.

FXNT.name: Foreign Exchange Related Netting
FXNT.definition: FX netting if cash is moved by separate wire instead of within the closing FX instruction

ADMG.name: Administrative Management
ADMG.definition: Transaction is related to a payment associated with administrative management.

BCDM.name: Bearer Cheque Domestic
BCDM.definition: Transaction is the payment of a domestic bearer cheque.

BCFG.name: Bearer Cheque Foreign
BCFG.definition: Transaction is the payment of a foreign bearer cheque.

BLDM.name: Building Maintenance
BLDM.definition: Transaction is related to a payment associated with building maintenance.

BNET.name: Bond Forward Netting
BNET.definition: Bond Forward pair-off cash net movement.

CBFF.name: Capital Building
CBFF.definition: Transaction is related to capital building fringe fortune, ie capital building in general.

CBFR.name: Capital Building Retirement
CBFR.definition: Transaction is related to capital building fringe fortune for retirement.

CCRD.name: Credit Card Payment
CCRD.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of credit card account.

CDBL.name: Credit Card Bill
CDBL.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of credit card bill.

CFEE.name: Cancellation Fee
CFEE.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of cancellation fee.

CGDD.name: Card Generated Direct Debit
CGDD.definition: Transaction is related to a direct debit where the mandate was generated by using data from a payment card at the point of sale.

CORT.name: Trade Settlement Payment
CORT.definition: Transaction is related to settlement of a trade, e.g. a foreign exchange deal or a securities transaction.

COST.name: Costs
COST.definition: Transaction is related to payment of costs.

CPKC.name: Carpark Charges
CPKC.definition: Transaction is related to carpark charges.

DCRD.name: Debit Card Payment
DCRD.definition: Transaction is related to a debit card payment.

DSMT.name: Printed Order Disbursement
DSMT.definition: Transaction is the payment of a disbursement due to a specific type of printed order for a payment of a  specified sum, issued by a bank or a post office (Zahlungsanweisung zur Verrechnung)

DVPM.name: Deliver Against Payment
DVPM.definition: Code used to pre-advise the account servicer of a forthcoming deliver against payment instruction.

EDUC.name: Education
EDUC.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of study/tuition fees.

FACT.name: Factor Update Related Payment
FACT.definition: Payment related to a factor update

FAND.name: Financial Aid In Case Of Natural Disaster
FAND.definition: Financial aid by State authorities for abolition of consequences of natural disasters.

FCPM.name: Late Payment Of Fees And Charges
FCPM.definition: Transaction is the payment for late fees & charges. E.g Credit card charges

GIFT.name: Gift
GIFT.definition: Payment with no commercial or statutory purpose.

GOVT.name: Government Payment
GOVT.definition: Transaction is a payment to or from a government department.

ICCP.name: Irrevocable Credit Card Payment
ICCP.definition: Transaction is reimbursement of credit card payment.

IDCP.name: Irrevocable Debit Card Payment
IDCP.definition: Transaction is reimbursement of debit card payment.

IHRP.name: Instalment Hire Purchase Agreement
IHRP.definition: Transaction is payment for an installment/hire-purchase agreement.

INSM.name: Installment
INSM.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of an installment.

IVPT.name: Invoice Payment
IVPT.definition: Transaction is the payment for invoices.

MCDM.name: Multi Curreny Cheque Domestic
MCDM.definition: Transaction is the payment of a domestic multi-currency cheque

MCFG.name: Multi Curreny Cheque Foreign
MCFG.definition: Transaction is the payment of a foreign multi-currency cheque

MSVC.name: Multiple Service Types
MSVC.definition: Transaction is related to a payment for multiple service types.

NOWS.name: Not Otherwise Specified
NOWS.definition: Transaction is related to a payment for type of services not specified elsewhere.

OCDM.name: Order Cheque Domestic
OCDM.definition: Transaction is the payment of a domestic order cheque

OCFG.name: Order Cheque Foreign
OCFG.definition: Transaction is the payment of a foreign order cheque

OFEE.name: Opening Fee
OFEE.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of opening fee.

PADD.name: Preauthorized Debit
PADD.definition: Transaction is related to a pre-authorized debit origination

PTSP.name: Payment Terms
PTSP.definition: Transaction is related to payment terms specifications

RCKE.name: Represented Check Entry
RCKE.definition: Transaction is related to a payment associated with a re-presented check entry

RCPT.name: Receipt Payment
RCPT.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of receipt.

REBT.name: Rebate
REBT.definition: Transaction is the payment of a rebate.

REFU.name: Refund
REFU.definition: Transaction is the payment of a refund.

RENT.name: Rent
RENT.definition: Transaction is the payment of rent.

REOD.name: Account Overdraft Repayment
REOD.definition: Transaction is for account overdraft repayment

RIMB.name: Reimbursement Of A Previous Erroneous Transaction
RIMB.definition: Transaction is related to a reimbursement of a previous erroneous transaction.

RPNT.name: Bilateral Repo Internet Netting
RPNT.definition: Bi-lateral repo interest net/bulk payment at rollover/pair-off or other closing scenarios where applicable.

RRBN.name: Round Robin
RRBN.definition: Cash payment resulting from a Round Robin

RRCT.name: Reimbursement Received Credit Transfer
RRCT.definition: Transaction is related to a reimbursement for commercial reasons of a correctly received credit transfer.

RRTP.name: Related Request To Pay
RRTP.definition: Transaction is related to a Request to Pay.

RVPM.name: Receive Against Payment
RVPM.definition: Code used to pre-advise the account servicer of a forthcoming receive against payment instruction.

SLPI.name: Payment Slip Instruction
SLPI.definition: Transaction is payment of a well formatted payment slip.

SPLT.name: Split Payments
SPLT.definition: Split payments. To be used when cash and security movements for a security trade settlement are instructed|separately.

STDY.name: Study
STDY.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of study/tuition costs.

TBAN.name: TBA Pair Off Netting
TBAN.definition: TBA pair-off cash wire net movement

TBIL.name: Telecommunications Bill
TBIL.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of telecommunications related bill.

TCSC.name: Town Council Service Charges
TCSC.definition: Transaction is related to a payment associated with charges levied by a town council.

TELI.name: Telephone Initiated Transaction
TELI.definition: Transaction is related to a payment initiated via telephone.

TMPG.name: TMPG Claim Payment
TMPG.definition: Cash payment resulting from a TMPG Claim

TPRP.name: Tri Party Repo Netting
TPRP.definition: Tri-party Repo related net gain/loss cash movement

TRNC.name: Truncated Payment Slip
TRNC.definition: Transaction is payment of a beneficiary prefilled payment slip where beneficiary to payer information is truncated.

TRVC.name: Traveller Cheque
TRVC.definition: Transaction is the payment of a travellers cheque

WEBI.name: Internet Initiated Transaction
WEBI.definition: Transaction is related to a payment initiated via internet.

IPAY.name: Instant Payments
IPAY.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately.

IPCA.name: Instant Payments Cancellation
IPCA.definition: Transaction in which the Return of the amount is fully returned.

IPDO.name: Instant Payments For Donations
IPDO.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately, done for donations, with sending the address data of the payer.

IPEA.name: Instant Payments In E Commerce Without Address Data
IPEA.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately, done in E-commerce, without sending the address data of the payer.

IPEC.name: Instant Payments In E Commerce With Address Data
IPEC.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately, done in E-commerce, with sending the address data of the payer.

IPEW.name: Instant Payments In E Commerce
IPEW.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately, done in E-commerce.

IPPS.name: Instant Payments At POS
IPPS.definition: Transaction in which the amount is available to the payee immediately, done at POS.

IPRT.name: Instant Payments Return
IPRT.definition: Transaction in which the Return of the amount is fully or partial returned.

IPU2.name: Instant Payments Unattended Vending Machine With 2 FA
IPU2.definition: Transaction is made via an unattending vending machine by using 2-factor-authentification.

IPUW.name: Instant Payments Unattended Vending Machine Without 2 FA
IPUW.definition: Transaction is made via an unattending vending machine by without using 2-factor-authentification.

ANNI.name: Annuity
ANNI.definition: Transaction settles annuity related to credit, insurance, investments, other.n

CAFI.name: Custodian Management Fee Inhouse
CAFI.definition: Transaction is the payment of custodian account management fee where custodian bank and current account servicing bank coincide.

CFDI.name: Capital Falling Due Inhouse
CFDI.definition: Transaction is the payment of capital falling due where custodian bank and current account servicing bank coincide.

DERI.name: Derivatives
DERI.definition: Transaction is related to a derivatives transaction.

FREX.name: Foreign Exchange
FREX.definition: Transaction is related to a foreign exchange operation.

HEDG.name: Hedging
HEDG.definition: Transaction is related to a hedging operation.

INVS.name: Investment And Securities
INVS.definition: Transaction is for the payment of mutual funds, investment products and shares

PRME.name: Precious Metal
PRME.definition: Transaction is related to a precious metal operation.

SAVG.name: Savings
SAVG.definition: Transfer to / from savings or to retirement account.

SECU.name: Securities
SECU.definition: Transaction is the payment of securities.

SEPI.name: Securities Purchase Inhouse
SEPI.definition: Transaction is the payment of a purchase of securities where custodian bank and current account servicing bank coincide

TREA.name: Treasury Payment
TREA.definition: Transaction is related to treasury operations.

UNIT.name: Unit Trust Purchase
UNIT.definition: Transaction is purchase of Unit Trust

FNET.name: Futures Netting Payment
FNET.definition: Cash associated with a netting of futures payments. Refer to CCPM codeword for netting of initial and variation margin through a CCP

FUTR.name: Futures
FUTR.definition: Cash related to futures trading activity.

ANTS.name: Anesthesia Services
ANTS.definition: Transaction is a payment for anesthesia services.

CVCF.name: Convalescent Care Facility
CVCF.definition: Transaction is a payment for convalescence care facility services.

DMEQ.name: Durable Medicale Equipment
DMEQ.definition: Transaction is a payment is for use of durable medical equipment.

DNTS.name: Dental Services
DNTS.definition: Transaction is a payment for dental services.

HLTC.name: Home Health Care
HLTC.definition: Transaction is a payment for home health care services.

HLTI.name: Health Insurance
HLTI.definition: Transaction is a payment of health insurance.

HSPC.name: Hospital Care
HSPC.definition: Transaction is a payment for hospital care services.

ICRF.name: Intermediate Care Facility
ICRF.definition: Transaction is a payment for intermediate care facility services.

LTCF.name: Long Term Care Facility
LTCF.definition: Transaction is a payment for long-term care facility services.

MAFC.name: Medical Aid Fund Contribution
MAFC.definition: Transaction is contribution to medical aid fund.

MARF.name: Medical Aid Refund
MARF.definition: Transaction is related to a medical aid refund.

MDCS.name: Medical Services
MDCS.definition: Transaction is a payment for medical care services.

VIEW.name: Vision Care
VIEW.definition: Transaction is a payment for vision care services.

CDEP.name: Credit Default Event Payment
